doc.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

title: Ray's first unreleased record in Richmond, Indiana
summary: Ray's first record, made in Richmond, Indiana with Johnny Bayersdorffer's band shortly after the Wolverines recorded, was never released. Other recordings with the band are discussed.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Remember your first record, Ray, that you made, your first group?

Well, the first record I actually made never did come out. It was made in Richmond, Indiana, with Johnny Bisonoff, his band. Oh, yeah. But they never did release those records. It was just a little bit after the Wolverines made their records.
Yeah, one of Johnny's records on OK came out, and Tom Brown and some of them were on that.
Well, I made some of those. I don't know which one I made on that. Who was it? I think Monk Hazel made those.
